ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I'd choose this for the mix of heavy riffs and melody that fits my recent metal listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try this for its aggressive sound and melodic passages after Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal sound appeals, but I'd leave it for another session.
ItemID: NA; Title: In Love & Death       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm more interested in heavier, riff-driven music than this emotional rock direction right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose its thrash intensity to follow the heavier side of Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: BLEEDING, THE UNCENSORED       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don't recognize this release confidently enough to choose it over familiar musical connections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Ten Thousand Fists makes this appealing, but I'd prioritize the melodic metal albums today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Faceless       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy grooves fit my hard rock interests, though it isn't my first choice this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: L.D. 50       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rhythmic complexity sounds appealing after Tool, but I'm choosing more melodic material today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Clayman; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I'd choose this first because Colony, Reroute to Remain, and Soundtrack to Your Escape give me a strong reason to explore more In Flames.
